summary.business_type: Hybrid Farm + Restaurant + Butcher (brick-and-mortar, Noci, Puglia, Italy)
top_findings: Missing security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options) — site vulnerable to MITM, XSS, clickjacking
No redirect strategy for domain variants — 4 URLs serve identical content without 301 redirects
Three.js bundle (664 KB) loaded on every page — should be route-specific lazy import
Base64-embedded fonts in 286 KB CSS file — blocks rendering, prevents independent caching
No reviews/social proof anywhere — critical trust gap for restaurant/agriturismo business
quick_wins: Add <link rel="preload" as="image" href="/images/masseria-luogo.jpg"> for LCP improvement
Fix telephone format in JSON-LD: remove tel: prefix, use E.164 format
Replace incorrect FarmAction schema type on /allevamento with LocalBusiness
Add missing canonical tag on /chi-siamo (one-line fix)
Add Prenota button to main header navigation

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Proper robots.txt with AI crawler strategy

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy all missing
findings.recommendation: Add via Cloudflare Transform Rules or _headers file

findings.title: No 301 redirects for domain variants
findings.description: All 4 URL variants (www/non-www, http/https) return 200
findings.recommendation: Configure 301 redirects in Cloudflare Page Rules

findings.title: Missing canonical on /chi-siamo
findings.description: Only page without self-referencing canonical tag
findings.recommendation: Add canonical tag in route meta

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod dates uniform/stale
findings.description: All lastmod values are build date, not content modification date
findings.recommendation: Use content-aware lastmod in build process

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Unique titles and meta descriptions on all pages

findings.title: Bottega H2 flat hierarchy
findings.description: 25 product names as H2 with no category grouping
findings.recommendation: Restructure: categories as H2, products as H3

findings.title: Homepage H1 lacks geo qualifier
findings.description: H1 does not include Noci or Puglia
findings.recommendation: Add geographic qualifier to visible H1 text

findings.title: 3 thin content pages
findings.description: Caseificio (472w), Prodotti (483w), Allevamento (514w) below 500 words
findings.recommendation: Expand with +150-300 words each adding E-E-A-T signals

findings.title: Weak E-E-A-T signals
findings.description: No staff names, years per activity, first-person experience narratives
findings.recommendation: Add team section, experience timeline, first-person stories

findings.title: Poor AI citation readiness
findings.description: Few discrete, verifiable factual claims for AI extraction
findings.recommendation: Embed 3-5 citable factual claims per page

findings.title: telephone uses tel: prefix
findings.description: Invalid format in global schema — tel: prefix not allowed
findings.recommendation: Remove tel: prefix, use E.164 format (+39...)

findings.title: FarmAction on /allevamento semantically wrong
findings.description: FarmAction is a CreativeWork subtype, not a business entity
findings.recommendation: Replace with LocalBusiness or Farm

findings.title: Inconsistent telephone format
findings.description: Arrays vs strings, tel: vs plain across different schemas
findings.recommendation: Standardize to single E.164 string format

findings.title: Missing image property on global schema
findings.description: No image in root layout JSON-LD
findings.recommendation: Add image URL to global schema

findings.title: Missing openingHoursSpecification
findings.description: Only /contatti has structured hours
findings.recommendation: Add to homepage and key pages

findings.title: No Organization schema on homepage
findings.description: Organization only on /chi-siamo
findings.recommendation: Add Organization with logo and sameAs to homepage

findings.title: Three.js 664KB on every page
findings.description: Loaded via shared layout, needed only on homepage
findings.recommendation: Move to route-specific lazy import

findings.title: Base64 fonts in 286KB CSS
findings.description: Blocks rendering, prevents independent font caching
findings.recommendation: Extract to separate .woff2 files with font-display: swap

findings.title: No LCP image preload
findings.description: Hero photo not preloaded
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel="preload" as="image"> for hero

findings.title: Large unoptimized SVGs
findings.description: logo-completo.svg (204KB), logo-emblema.svg (172KB)
findings.recommendation: Optimize with svgo or convert to PNG for non-vector needs

findings.title: Only 13/100+ images lazy-loaded
findings.description: Most below-fold images lack loading="lazy"
findings.recommendation: Add loading="lazy" to all non-LCP images

findings.title: No WebP/AVIF fallback
findings.description: Most images JPEG-only
findings.recommendation: Generate WebP variants with <picture> fallback

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Correct AI crawler strategy (blocks training, allows citability)

findings.title: No /llms.txt discovery file
findings.description: Returns 404 — AI systems cannot discover site structure
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt with site description and key page URLs

findings.title: No /.well-known/ai-plugin.json
findings.description: Returns 404 — AI agent platforms cannot discover capabilities
findings.recommendation: Add ai-plugin.json describing Bottega ordering and contact info

findings.title: No FAQ on homepage for AI snippets
findings.description: FAQ content exists but not on main pages
findings.recommendation: Add FAQ sections with FAQPage schema to key pages

findings.title: No sameAs links to external authorities
findings.description: Brand entity consistent but not linked to GBP, TripAdvisor etc.
findings.recommendation: Add sameAs array to Organization schema

categories.name: Images
what_works: Strong visual design system with CSS custom properties

findings.title: 10+ images missing alt attributes
findings.description: Bottega, Agriturismo, Hero, Footer images lack alt text entirely
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text to every meaningful image

findings.title: 3 images with empty alt="" unverified
findings.description: May be correct (decorative) but not verified
findings.recommendation: Audit each empty-alt image to confirm decorative purpose

findings.title: Above-fold hero relies on JS rendering
findings.description: Three.js + GSAP required for hero content visibility
findings.recommendation: Ensure SSR output includes visible hero text with noscript fallback

findings.title: No reviews/social proof

findings.recommendation: Add 3-5 curated testimonials with names to homepage and /agriturismo

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add security headers via Cloudflare (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy)
Configure 301 redirects for all domain variants → https://www.masseriadongianvito.it
Move Three.js to route-specific lazy import (save 664 KB on non-homepage routes)
Extract base64 fonts to separate .woff2 files with font-display: swap
Add LCP image preload for hero photo
Fix telephone format in all JSON-LD: remove tel: prefix, use E.164
Replace FarmAction with LocalBusiness on /allevamento
Add image property to global schema
Add review/testimonial section to homepage and /agriturismo

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add openingHoursSpecification to global schema
Add Organization with logo and sameAs to homepage schema
Add LocalBusiness to homepage JSON-LD @type array
Add Prenota button to main header navigation
Restructure Bottega H2 hierarchy: categories as H2, products as H3
Clarify /prodotti vs /bottega distinction or consolidate
Optimize large SVGs (logo-completo.svg 204KB, logo-emblema.svg 172KB)
Add loading=lazy to all below-fold images
Fix 10+ missing alt attributes across Bottega, Agriturismo, Hero, Footer
Create /llms.txt for AI discovery
Add Menu schema to /agriturismo

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Expand thin content pages (+150-300 words each: Caseificio, Prodotti, Allevamento)
Add E-E-A-T experience signals (staff names, years active, first-person narratives)
Embed 3-5 citable factual claims per page for AI extraction
Generate WebP/AVIF variants for key images
Compress large JPEGs (>400KB) to quality 80-85 or WebP
Add BreadcrumbList to all main pages missing it
Enrich /prodotti ItemList with Product/Offer data
Add aggregateRating to homepage and agriturismo schema
Add Google Business Profile link in footer
Create /.well-known/ai-plugin.json and webmcp.json
Add simple booking/contact form to /agriturismo
Add certification badges visually

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up Google API credentials for CrUX field data and GSC indexation monitoring
Monitor AI crawler user-agents quarterly, update robots.txt
Manual a11y testing (keyboard + screen reader) quarterly
Add newsletter signup in footer
Create event/venue section for event planners
Add recipe/pairing content for food enthusiasts
Create press kit page with downloadable assets
Fix sitemap lastmod to use real content modification dates

limitations: No Google API credentials — CWV are lab-based estimates
No Matomo credentials — organic traffic unavailable
No backlink API credentials — limited to Common Crawl domain metrics
Screenshots not captured — analysis based on source code inspection
Lighthouse not run — no local Chrome binary
Client-rendered content may differ from SSR HTML analysis
